'''Zeed Venom''' was a [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Guild]]-sponsored [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Venom traveled to [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] to collect a bounty. The bounty hunter wore [[Bounty hunter armor|specialized armor]].<ref name="Game" />

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on which scenario is played, Venom is either trying to collect 25000 credits from [[Vok]] or kill him due to an unpaid gambling debt or capture [[Cambra Del]] and return her to a loan shark for a reward of 20000 credits.<ref name="Game" />
